en-US: Improve architecture diagram viewing and editing across platforms: render diagrams with X6 on mobile, add richer components and clearer diagram labels on Web and desktop, unify expansion and save feedback, and keep diagram metadata out of regular notes.
Fix desktop sync failures caused by merged memo ordering and foreign-key constraints.
zh-CN: 增强架构图在各端的浏览与编辑体验：移动端使用 X6 渲染，Web 与桌面端提供更丰富的组件和更清晰的图表标识，统一展开与保存反馈，并避免图表元数据出现在普通笔记中。
修复桌面端合并备忘录顺序导致的外键约束同步失败。
